latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Editor to Generator.

- Instantly convert your edited video footage into fully generated videos with AI-driven transitions, music, and text overlays.
- Supports uploads up to 500MB (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, and more).
- Automated cloud setup with free trial credits and seamless session management.
- One command workflow: upload, describe, get a generated 1080p MP4 in 1-2 minutes.
- Transparent error handling for file type, size, credits, and authentication issues.
